_meta.description: Hindu temples, gurdwaras, and mosques in the US with event calendars. Expanded 2026-10-10 to 41 hindutemples.info cities (261 temples) per Kiran's directive.
_meta.usage: temple-events-scraper.py reads this file. parser_type determines how events are extracted.

parser_types.angular_spa: Angular/React SPA - requires API discovery, may not be scrapable via curl
parser_types.google_calendar: Embedded Google Calendar iframe - extract calendar ID from page
parser_types.json_ld: Static HTML with schema.org/Event JSON-LD blocks
parser_types.static_html: Server-rendered HTML with parseable event listings
parser_types.hindutemples_info: Scrape Upcoming Festivals from hindutemples.info temple page (festivals only, no weekly pujas)
